name: FUN_DOCIO_FLOWS_B
description: This table provides information about the seeded input and output flows of the document. The input and output flows of the document are seeded by the respective products for all flows they intend to enable in the input and output of the document. This table serves as a  persistent table that includes the seeded flows, detailed flow information, and associated default configuration values. Flow code must be specified for each document to be proceseed by the input and output of the document to determine the appropriate flow for execution.

columns.name: FLOW_ID
columns.description: Identifies the unique identifier for the input and output flow of the document IO.

columns.name: FLOW_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the input and output flow of the document.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FAMILY
columns.description: Product family for the Document IO flow.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CODE
columns.description: Product code for the Document IO flow.

columns.name: BUSINESS_OBJECT
columns.description: Business object for the Document IO flow.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_PATTERN_CODE
columns.description: Identifies integration pattern code. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_INTEG_PATTERNS.

columns.name: ADMIN_SUBMISSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether input and output flow of this document can be submitted by an administrator.

columns.name: ON_DEMAND_PURGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether on demand purge is enabled.

columns.name: AUTOMATIC_PURGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether automatic purge is enabled.

columns.name: LOADER_DOCUMENT_STORE
columns.description: Document store for the Document IO flow.

columns.name: RESOURCE_PLAN
columns.description: Resource plan for the Document IO flow.

columns.name: USER_INVOCABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether input and output flow can be invoked by enduser.

columns.name: FLOW_DIRECTION_CODE
columns.description: Identifies flow direction code. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_FLOW_DIRS.

columns.name: PRODUCT_ENDPOINT
columns.description: Indicates the product endpoint of the input and output flow of the document.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether input and output flow of this document is active.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
